name: 34714 · Clermont, FL
findings: ZIP 34714 (Clermont) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34714 (Clermont) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
